backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 so grad accumulation halves). In a fixed 300s budget, more optimizer steps usually help a small model.

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.3 so more training happens at full LR.

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 for a longer decay phase.

backlog.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1 for Muon cautious decay.

backlog.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR to 0.4.

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.95).
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.9

backlog.spec: Set ASPECT_RATIO = 80 (dim 640) keeping DEPTH 8.
backlog.title: Aspect ratio 80 at depth 8

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 giving twice as many heads; check that the flash/attention code handles it.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SL" for more full-context layers, or "SSSS"-with-final-L variant, to compare attention coverage vs speed.
backlog.title: Window pattern all long except short quarter

backlog.spec: Reduce the short-window size from half context to quarter context (seq_len//4) for S layers to speed up attention.
backlog.title: Shorter windows pattern LLLL→SSSL with quarter context

backlog.spec: Reduce MLP hidden multiplier from 4x to 3x (if using relu^2) and spend savings on speed; keep code simple.
backlog.title: ReLU^2 to SwiGLU-free tweak: MLP expansion 3x

backlog.spec: Change the final logit softcap value (likely 15 or 30) to 15, or add softcap if absent.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Ensure attention and MLP output projections (c_proj) are zero-initialized if not already, for a stable start.
backlog.title: Zero-init output projections

backlog.spec: If value embeddings are used on alternating layers, try applying them on all layers or only the last half to check the effect on loss and memory.
backlog.title: Untied value-embedding drop on alternating layers

backlog.spec: Shorten Muon momentum ramp (e.g., 0.85→0.95 over 150 steps instead of 300), or raise final momentum to 0.97.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

backlog.spec: Reduce Muon Newton-Schulz iterations from 5 to 4 to save time per step.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz steps 4

backlog.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer step for stability at higher LR.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping 1.0

backlog.spec: Set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32 with accumulation doubled; may reduce memory pressure and allow torch.compile faster kernels. Check throughput.
backlog.title: Device batch 32 for memory/speed

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown shape with a cosine shape: multiplier = 0.5*(1+cos(pi*progress_in_warmdown)) while keeping the same WARMDOWN_RATIO.
backlog.title: Time-based LR schedule with cosine warmdown

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**16 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 so each optimizer step is one 32x2048 microbatch (grad accum stays 1). This gives roughly twice as many optimizer steps in 300 s. Keep all LRs unchanged. If the code asserts divisibility, make sure TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE is divisible by DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE*MAX_SEQ_LEN.
backlog.title: Total batch 2**16 with grad accumulation removed

backlog.spec: Make Muon cautious weight decay follow the training progress: wd = WEIGHT_DECAY * (1 - progress), where progress is the time-based fraction of the 300 s budget already used. Update the Muon param-group weight_decay value each step at the same place the LR and momentum schedules are updated.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH to 10 and ASPECT_RATIO to 51 so model_dim is about 512 (rounded to a multiple of HEAD_DIM 128, i.e. 512). This keeps width and adds layers. The model is deeper and a bit slower per step. Check that the existing model_dim rounding gives a multiple of HEAD_DIM. Leave everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Depth 10 with aspect ratio 51

backlog.spec: Find the logit soft-capping constant in the forward pass (tanh(logits/cap)*cap, probably 30) and set it to 15. If no softcap exists, add logits = 15*tanh(logits/15) on float logits before the loss.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 15

backlog.spec: Reduce the number of Newton-Schulz iterations in the Muon orthogonalization from 5 to 4 (the ns_steps argument or the loop count). This lowers optimizer time per step, so more steps fit in 300 s. Keep the coefficients unchanged.
backlog.title: Muon Newton-Schulz 4 steps

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the model has twice as many attention heads at the same width. Make sure n_head and n_kv_head are derived from model_dim // HEAD_DIM and that any value-embedding or rotary shapes follow. Leave other settings unchanged.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Change the MLP hidden size from 4*n_embd to 3*n_embd (c_fc out features and c_proj in features). This makes each step faster and the model smaller, which helps in a 300 s budget. Keep ReLU^2 and the initialization scheme.
backlog.title: MLP expansion 3x

backlog.spec: Change EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008 in a single run. At the smaller batch size the Adam LRs may be too high for embeddings and too low for lm_head. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.3 and unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown in the LR multiplier function with a cosine decay. Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO at 0.5. In the warmdown phase, with p going from 0 to 1, use mult = FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1 - FINAL_LR_FRAC) * 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * p)). The multiplier is continuous at the start of warmdown and ends at FINAL_LR_FRAC.
backlog.title: Cosine warmdown shape

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN to "SSSS" so the code's rule makes the final layer full context. Check whether the code forces the last layer to long. If it does not, force it. Short windows speed up attention, so more steps fit in 300 s. Leave everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Window pattern all short except last layer

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**16 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 (32x2048 tokens per step, so there is no gradient accumulation). This gives about twice as many optimizer steps in 300 s. Since 2**17 helped a lot, test whether the trend continues. Leave the LRs unchanged. If the Muon or Adam code assumes a particular batch size, keep it unchanged.
backlog.title: Batch 2**16 with device batch 32

backlog.spec: In one run, combine UNEMBEDDING_LR=0.008, WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.7, ADAM_BETAS=(0.8, 0.99), and gradient-norm clipping at 1.0 before optimizer.step() (torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_ over model.parameters()). Each gave a small gain of about 0.001 to 0.003 on its own. This tests whether they add up beyond noise.
backlog.title: Combined best small gains

backlog.spec: Reduce the MLP hidden size from 4*dim to 3*dim, which makes each step faster and the model smaller. In the 300 s budget the model gets more steps. Change only the hidden width of the MLP's up and down projections, and keep the ReLU^2 activation.
backlog.title: MLP expansion 3x

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM to 64 so the model has 10 heads at dim 512. The number of heads is derived from model_dim // HEAD_DIM. Check that rotary embeddings and the value-embedding gating still work with the new head count. Keep all other settings the same.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR to 0.3 and UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008. The unembedding doubling was the best single tweak so far, and the token embedding LR of 0.6 may now be too high at the smaller batch size.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.3 with unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Change the LR schedule's warmdown from linear to cosine. During the warmdown phase, use the multiplier FINAL_LR_FRAC + (1 - FINAL_LR_FRAC) * 0.5 * (1 + cos(pi * (1 - r))), where r is the fraction of the warmdown phase that remains (1 at its start, 0 at its end). Keep WARMDOWN_RATIO at 0.5.
backlog.title: Cosine warmdown shape

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1. With about 4x more steps than the original baseline, 0.2 may over-regularize a model that is trained for only 300 s.
backlog.title: Halve weight decay to 0.1

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH to 4 and ASPECT_RATIO to 128 (model_dim 512 with HEAD_DIM 128 gives 4 heads). Use a short WINDOW_PATTERN such as 'SL' if the pattern code requires it. A shallower model is much faster per step and may win in a 300 s budget. Check that the pattern still ends with a full-context last layer.
backlog.title: Bolder: wider shallow model with 4 layers

memo:
Helped: only the batch size change. Cutting TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**17 (slot 4) gave more steps in 300 s: official 1.0519 and 1.0525, mean_adjusted 1.0522, about -0.0624 vs the old baseline. It carries a tripwire flag, so find out why before building on it.
Did not help: optimizer, schedule and architecture tweaks, all rejected. Most deltas at the new batch size were small (-0.0005 to -0.0013), which may be noise. DEPTH 10 was worse (+0.0156). WARMUP_RATIO 0.03 gave +0.0021. The best single change was doubling UNEMBEDDING_LR to 0.008 (-0.0029), still rejected.
Next: investigate the tripwire first. Then try TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**16 (2**18 was aborted as a no-op). Combine the small gains in one run: UNEMBEDDING_LR 0.008, WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.7, gradient clipping and beta2 0.99. Replicate any winner to separate it from noise.
